subject: Sandbox bridge request — short sprint grant needed
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@kitehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short sandbox bridge while PO clears

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note — our procurement team at KiteHealth has run into a vendor onboarding gate with our legal vendor registry. The PO for the pilot is approved internally but the vendor portal account is stuck pending a security questionnaire (should clear, but we don't have an ETA).

We have a customer-facing sprint starting Monday and losing access to the sandbox will derail a demo and two integrations the team needs to validate. Can Redwood provide a short bridge of sandbox tokens (48–72 hours or an interim sandbox seat) so our engineers can finish the sprint while procurement finishes the paperwork?

I attached our procurement status screenshot for context. Happy to sign a short-term agreement or accept conditional terms if that helps.

Thanks — really appreciate the help.

— Aisha
Aisha Patel | Senior Product Manager | KiteHealth
aisha.patel@kitehealth.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: kitehealth_procurement_snapshot.png (image)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@kitehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox bridge while PO clears

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the screenshot — that helps. We can provision a short bridge while procurement finishes the vendor onboarding. Before I commit the credits, I need internal approvals for the amount and the conditional terms (signed PO or payment within 14 days of bridge start).

Tentatively we can offer a 72-hour sandbox grant with one dedicated seat and 100k token allowance. If that works for you, can you confirm the expected PO-signed date and whether KiteHealth can accept the conditional 14-day hold? If not, tell me what timeline your procurement expects and we can discuss alternatives (reduced tokens, shorter window).

I'll loop in Camila from Sales Ops to sign-off and Michael from Finance if we need to apply a temporary exception.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

[Attachment placeholders not included]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short sandbox bridge while PO clears

Folks — forwarding KiteHealth's ask. TL;DR: procurement says PO is approved but vendor portal is pending security onboarding; they need the sandbox live for a 3-day sprint starting Monday.

Proposal: 72-hour sandbox bridge, 1 seat, 100k token allowance. Conditional on signed PO or payment capture within 14 days. Any objections? If agreed, I'll send the confirmation to Aisha and log the bridge in HubSpot.

Camila — will Sales Ops need a special code or memo to track this as a temporary grant? Michael — are there finance flags we should be aware of for the 14-day conditional?

Thanks —
Stephanie
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short sandbox bridge while PO clears

Stephanie / Michael —

I'm OK with the 72-hour grant and the 100k token cap. Please include the following conditions in the bridge confirmation:
- KiteHealth provides an expected PO-signed date and the PO draft (we should keep the PO number or DocuSign link on file).
- If PO/signed payment isn't received within 14 days of the bridge start, the sandbox access will be disabled and any overage will be invoiced at standard rates.
- Bridge will be logged as a temporary non-billable credit under deal KTH-2026-043 for reporting.

Michael — please confirm we don't need CFO approval for this sized bridge; if you need me to reduce the token allowance to 50k to avoid extra approvals, say the word.

Camila Reyes
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@kitehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kitehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox bridge while PO clears

Hi Stephanie / Camila —

Thank you — that works. We accept the 72-hour bridge with the 100k token cap under the 14-day conditional terms. Our procurement lead expects the DocuSign PO to be routed by EOD Friday (2026-09-03) — I'll attach the PO draft this afternoon and follow up with procurement for the portal clearance.

Tom and I will coordinate the kickoff with our engineers so the sprint doesn't get delayed. Appreciate the flexibility — we'll keep you updated and deliver the PO draft to the DocuSign link you provided.

Best,
Aisha

Attachments: KiteHealth_PO_Draft.pdf (pdf)
